sections.title: Link Map and Scenarios
sections.html: This document shows how the features connect: which features depend on which others, how data flows, and which features a user moves through in a real-life scenario.

sections.title: Link map
sections.html:
Link map

Key points from the diagram:

  • Two daily loops: task → child marks it done → parent approves → stars → reward → reward request → approval, and mark done → record how the child did it → stage and suggestions → adjust the task.
  • The plan is the gateway to most parent areas: the trial and plan determine the number of children and whether management features are available.
  • Referrals go through payment: the code gives a discount before purchase, and a successful payment generates a commission.

sections.title: A. A new family, from learning about the app to a steady routine
sections.html:
A. A new family, from learning about the app to a steady routine

  1. Click 7-Day Free Trial → sign in with Google → set up your family (the trial starts automatically).
  2. Create a child profile, load six age-based tasks, or choose from the framework. Create a few rewards.
  3. Pair a device for your child; set a PIN.
  4. Choose one or two tasks and set a cue. Each day, your child marks tasks done, you approve them, and give specific praise.
  5. Each week, look back for 5 minutes; use the suggestions to add a task, keep the rhythm, or adjust a task.
  6. Before day 7, choose a plan to continue (you can enter a referral code before paying).

sections.title: B. Add a second child
sections.html:
B. Add a second child

Children → Add. You need an active plan or trial (the Basic plan allows up to 1 child; the Pro plan and the trial allow up to 5). Each child has a separate code and device; each device can be revoked separately.

sections.title: C. Your family is away or someone is ill
sections.html:
C. Your family is away or someone is ill

Choose Take a break: the streak is preserved, missed days are not counted, and task reminders stop. Choose Resume when you return.

sections.title: D. Refer a friend
sections.html:
D. Refer a friend

Join the programme → send the link → your friend enters the code and gets 10% off when buying a yearly plan → your friend pays → you have a commission held for 40 days (still frozen while the order has an open refund or billing case) → set a PIN and save your payout details → request a withdrawal → admin transfers the money.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
sections.html:
Troubleshooting

SymptomCommon causeWhat to do
Child marks a task done and sees "Could not save. Please try again." with a code in parenthesesCheck the code belowThe card returns to its previous state; try again
Code no-childA child profile could not be selected on this device (fixed when opening Kid Mode from the parent's account)Reload the page; if it remains, contact support with the code
Code no-sessionThe device is not signed in or has not been pairedSign in again as a parent, or pair again with the code on the child device
Code no-activityThe task was just deleted or has not loadedReload the page
Code request-401The session has expiredSign in again
Code request-403You do not have permission or the PIN must be unlockedEnter the PIN or use the correct account
Code request-409The server rejected the change (for example, a date outside the allowed range, or a profile or task no longer matches)Reload and choose a date close to today
Code points-spentStars from this task have already been spent on a reward, so the change cannot be undoneKeep it as is, or have a parent adjust the stars
Code error-…Network or other errorCheck your connection and try again
After marking a task done, no stars appearThe task needs parent approvalApprove it
QR code cannot be scannedCamera permission has not been granted, or the connection is not using httpsGrant permission or enter the code manually
Pairing code rejectedThe code was refreshed, or too many incorrect attempts were madeGet a new code from Children; wait a few minutes if you are rate-limited
Payment transferred but plan has not appearedWaiting for PayOS confirmationWait a few minutes and reopen /checkout; do not pay again; contact support with the order code (activation)
Cannot add a child profileThe plan has expired, the Basic plan already has 1 child, or the Pro plan already has 5Buy a plan or upgrade
Referral code field is missingThe family has already paid, the recording window has expired, or a code already existsNo additional code can be recorded (8)
Cannot withdraw commissionNo PIN set, less than 200,000 VND, the amount is still within the hold period, or payout details were just changed (24-hour wait)See request a withdrawal
Child cannot see the public leaderboardSharing is off, the child has not been selected, or the family is pausedEnable sharing and select the child
Day streak is lostMore than one day passed without a confirmed taskCheck the count again; Take a break helps next time
Login or lifecycle email does not arriveIt went to spam; the address previously bounced; email-code sign-in is disabledCheck spam; use Google
Child's device is lostAccess needs to be blockedRevoke the device and refresh the code

When contacting support (Contact): send the support code, time, and the action you just took. Do not send passwords, PINs, or unexpired pairing codes.
